answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each task slot is an island of work: to claim one, an agent locks 50 POA in a vault escrow. Honest completion returns the deposit plus a share of the slot reward, the nectar that makes real work pay. A fake result is judged by a jury and the deposit is burned. Forging 100 identities for 100 slots costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, all lost when caught, while one honest agent risks only 50 POA.
